name: Barber

pf.license.need: always: barbering is licensed where the state's rules require it
pf.license.who: both: the shop holds a barbershop license, and each barber holds their own barber license
pf.license.ask: the shop's license number; each barber's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.away: house calls and event work only where the state's rules allow barbering away from a licensed shop; some states allow it only for some services, or only for barbers with more years, a background check or insurance (switches from the state form)
pf.license.mobile: a mobile barbering company gives the license the state's form names for work away from a shop, where one exists
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, and proof of it when a venue asks
pf.license.booth: a booth renter is their own business: their own barber license, a renter's license where the state issues one, their own prices, rules, calendar and Stripe
pf.license.skinCare: skin care (an esthetician's work: facials, brows, waxing) is its own kind of work, with its own license where the state asks

stop.words: a dye reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, trouble breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rinse the dye off with plenty of water.

stop.words: a deep cut that won't stop bleeding
stop.say: Press a clean cloth on it and call 911.

goOn.words: a rash, an open sore, an infection or lice on the scalp or face
goOn.what: no razor or color on it; the barber checks before starting; the visit goes on with what's safe, or moves with no fee

goOn.words: an itchy or red scalp or beard after a home dye, with no swelling
goOn.what: rinse with cool water and use no more dye; the barber checks the skin before any color, and a color waits for a skin test

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Skin test for beard color (a small test for a reaction to hair dye)
steps.when: at least 48 hours before beard or hair color, the time the dye's label sets
steps.who: new color clients, and anyone whose last test has run out
steps.goodFor: 3 months (the example shop's rule), or until the dye changes
steps.result: the barber checks the spot before mixing any color; redness or itching calls the color off, with no fee

pf.first_steps.away: none for house calls or events: color stays at the shop

pf.visit.checkIn: at the shop: the check-in code at the chair or the front desk; a walk-in gets a code when he's next; at a home or venue: the code from whoever will be there (the groom or the venue contact when a mobile is given for them)
pf.visit.beforeWork: the barber goes over the reference photo, the guard numbers and the beard first, and checks the skin before a razor or color
pf.visit.changes: anything added at the chair (a beard trim, a line-up) is priced and OK'd before it's done; booked customers go first, and a walk-in starts only if it fits before the next booking
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the barber; guard numbers, the style and any skin-test date go in the barber's notes for next time

pf.money.before: at the shop: a card saved for the $20 fee, and paid at the chair (the Groom's package takes a $40 deposit when booked); a home or office visit: a card saved for the $89 fee; a groom's cut at home is paid in full when booked; a wedding party: a 25% deposit when booked
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting; many barbershops pick 2 hours for a cut)
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $20 at the shop ($40 for the Groom's package); $89 for a home or office visit; a wedding party: the deposit may be kept, never more. Sam confirms each fee, never more than what was paid now or agreed; no card and no deposit, no fee
pf.money.repeat: after 2 no-shows or late cancels with no card, the shop can ask that customer for a card to book (the owner's setting)
pf.money.refunds: a full refund if the shop changes the plan, or a skin test rules color out
pf.money.tips: on: at the chair (the reader or cash), or a tip line on the bill Rosie texts; tips go to the barber
pf.money.tax: a tax line for products sold, where the state's rules require it

pf.messages.never: dye-reaction, skin-test and skin or scalp answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record; the customer never hears why a barber is out
pf.messages.photos: a reference photo only on the secure page; the barber sees it by private link
pf.messages.minors: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each barber's license per state; skin care where the state licenses it
pf.staff.skills: cuts, fades, beard work, razor shaves, kids cuts, beard color, house calls and events; only barbers who do color are offered for beard color
pf.staff.supervision: apprentices and students work only under a licensed barber, where the state's rules allow
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs a group of 3 or more at the shop, a booking after a past dye reaction, and any wedding party quote over $500
pf.staff.standIn: a barber out: another barber who does that service, at the same time and price; the stand-in gets the cut notes
pf.staff.away: only barbers cleared for work away from the shop are offered for house calls and events
pf.staff.booth: a booth renter's bookings are their own, never sent to the shop's owner

pf.rules.showLicense: each barber's license and the shop's posted where the state's rules require it; the license number in texts where the state asks
pf.rules.away: barbering away from the shop only where the state allows it, and only for the services it allows (a switch from the state form)
pf.rules.booth: booth rental only where the state allows it; a renter's license or a written agreement where the state's rules require one
pf.rules.receipt: what a receipt must show, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.minors: a parent's written OK for color on a minor, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.records: skin-test dates and cut notes kept with the customer's record: 7 years, or longer where the state asks
pf.rules.contracts: a signed contract for wedding party work (the owner's setting), and where the state's rules require one above an amount

pf.edges.lateArrival: 10 minutes' grace; 10 to 20 minutes late, a shorter cut in the time left or a later time; after 20 minutes it's a no-show, and the chair goes to walk-ins

pf.edges.standIn: a barber out sick: another barber who does that service, at the same time and price, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.skinTest: a skin test not done in time: later times that keep the 48 hours, or the cut without color
pf.edges.repeatNoShow: after 2 no-shows or late cancels with no card, a card is needed to book (the owner's setting)
pf.edges.group: a group of 3 or more: one booking, chairs side by side, Sam's OK first, one check-in code
pf.edges.weddingDay: a wedding day can't move: a stand-in with the skill, or a full refund
pf.edges.fix: a free fix-up within 7 days of a cut (the example shop's promise)

notes:
Refit R11 (Tue Oct 27 2026, frozen master, refit-Q01). Started from the hair pilot (chair pattern): a barbershop runs like a salon, with a chosen barber, walk-ins in a line, and payment at the chair.
Names: Sam's main company is Lee Mobile Barbers LLC (500 Lake St; barbering at homes and events; skin care as its second kind of work). His second company is the master's Lee's Barbershop LLC (88 Elm St). Riley and Avery cut at the shop; Andre and Malik go to homes (the master's Jordan and Casey, renamed).
Facts: children (a kids cut has a parent), documents (a signed contract for a wedding party), extrawork (a service added at the chair or on the visit), groups (a group of 3 or more; a wedding party's final count), photos (a wedding party or a color quote from photos). Settings: set start in both flows; free cancel 24 hours before. No switches: no2 is off (the $2 applies, D97); no license check (D96).
Money, flow A (at the shop): list|card|counter (main: haircut $35, card saved for the $20 fee, paid at the chair); list|none|counter (haircut $35, nothing taken, a YES books it); list|deposit|counter (Groom's package $140, $40 deposit, $100 rest at the chair; the $40 is the fee if it's missed). Beard trim as a second service ($20).
Money, flow B (at the customer's place): list|card|bill (main: home grooming visit $179, card saved for the $89 late-cancel and no-show fee, the bill texted after with a tip line); list|full|none (groom's cut at home $150 paid in full, fee $89); photos|deposit|bill (wedding party of 4 quoted at $640 from photos and OK'd by Sam: $160 deposit, $480 rest on the bill; fee $160, never more than the deposit). No holds (D66); the rest is never charged on a set day; an added service (beard trim, line-up) is priced and OK'd at the chair and paid at the visit.
Sign-up: A S1-13 and B S1-13 are the barber's own money cards with per-path variants for the listed paths (after:counter, before:none+after:counter, before:deposit+after:counter; after:bill, before:full, price:photos+before:deposit+after:bill). B S1-38 is the shop's price board and the one rule set (fees: $20, $40 for the Groom's package).
Removed: the old money cards with holds ($40 fee held, $89 held, a rest charged on a set day), money vary keys that tied with the master's variants, the house call and travel-fee items from flow A's paths, the children's 'child is in the pro's care' branch and the rating's named-only branch (off). Plumbing and electrical sample words are renamed to the barber's words; leftovers that are privacy words ('a leak is stopped and told') are kept.
Not sure (for the verifier): (1) B's wedding deposit fee $160 = the deposit (pay.late 'may keep ... from what you paid'); (2) the Saturday-morning bill on the shop path was dropped (a barber alone at the shop is paid at the chair); (3) the travel fee row in the price list is a fee inside the home visit's price; (4) he/him for Andre and Malik (staff) is kept, Alex has no pronoun in the master.
Steps still changing before the freeze's last edits: none (the master is frozen).
